delete.description: Forwards agent_connection.delete to the connected paxd control tunnel without deleting the cloud Agent.

patch.description: Forwards agent_connection.update to the connected paxd control tunnel.

post.description: Forwards agent_connection.restart to the connected paxd control tunnel.
Sets the paxd agent connection desired state to stopped.
Owner-authorized, transient browser operator requests. Credentials remain on the node. No arbitrary proxy routes are accepted.

get.description: Forwards command.get to the connected paxd control tunnel.
Forwards a harnesses.list query to the connected paxd control tunnel.

post.description: Forwards a harnesses.discover query to the connected paxd control tunnel.
Cancels a restart or upgrade before binary activation or shutdown is committed.
Forwards paxd.restart to the connected paxd control tunnel.

get.description: Forwards a secret_channel.open query to the connected paxd control tunnel. Returns a short-lived, single-use public key generated by paxd; pax-manager never holds the private key and never sees plaintext encrypted against it.

post.description: Forwards secret_channel.push to the connected paxd control tunnel as opaque ciphertext sealed against a previously opened channel's public key; pax-manager relays these bytes without decrypting them.

get.description: Forwards a status.get query to the connected paxd control tunnel.

post.description: Forwards paxd.upgrade to the connected paxd control tunnel.
Forwards paxl.upgrade. Poll daemon/commands/:command_id for verified completion. Does not restart paxd.

post.description: Worker-only idempotent provisioning. Requires X-Pax-Timestamp and X-Pax-Signature: hex HMAC-SHA256 of pax-region-ensure-v1 followed by newline, timestamp, newline and the exact request body. Uses the region-specific provisioning secret. Timestamp expires after 30 seconds. Disabled without PAX_REGION.
